rationale: The assistant reached the correct conclusion, that this is the normal anti-crease phase, and recommended no part or engineer. It was weak on the way there: the first reply suggested a control fault or stuck relay, the second and third detoured into child lock and delay start, and the last reply wrongly said anti-crease 'cannot be permanently disabled without specialist service'. It never pointed the customer to the manual to turn the setting off or to unload promptly, and it never asked about heating.
